title: DialogStateMachine
description: Formalizes the micro-flow and macro-flow state machines of the dialog model. Micro-flows govern per-field interaction (capture/confirm/correct), macro-flows govern cross-field-group navigation and process completion (review/submit). States and transitions documented in model.md 2.6.1-2.6.2 are normative; this schema makes them machine-readable and independently testable.

microFlow.description: Per-field interaction state machine: capture, interpret, validate, confirm/repair cycle.

macroFlow.description: Cross-field-group navigation state machine: field-group intro, field loop, summary, submit/cancel.

MicroStateId.description: Micro-flow state identifiers for per-field interaction. PROMPTING speaks label/help, LISTENING captures speech, INTERPRETING maps transcript to intent/value, VALIDATING checks constraints, CONFIRMATION presents recognized value for user acceptance, ERROR_PROMPT announces validation failure with remediation, REPAIR represents field-level correction; richer runtimes may realize it as slot-, word-, or character-level repair.

MacroStateId.description: Macro-flow state identifiers for cross-field-group navigation. FIELD_GROUP_INTRO speaks the voiceSummary for orientation, FIELD_LOOP iterates over fields within the active field group, FIELD_GROUP_SUMMARY recaps entered values before advancing, PROCESS_SUMMARY presents the full review before submission, SUBMITTED marks successful completion, CANCELLED marks user-initiated abort.

MicroTransitionTrigger.description: Triggers that cause micro-flow state transitions.

MacroTransitionTrigger.description: Triggers that cause macro-flow state transitions.

to.description: Target state. Use null to indicate exit from the current field micro-flow so the runtime can advance to the next field or macro-flow transition.

guard.description: Optional guard condition in plain language. Runtime interprets guards; the schema documents them for traceability.
Optional guard condition in plain language.

MicroStateDefinition.description: Definition of a single micro-flow state with its entry action and allowed transitions.

entryAction.description: Action performed on entering this state (e.g. 'Speak field label and help text').

privacyBehavior.description: Privacy-dependent behavior in this state (e.g. 'Masked readback for sensitive fields, opt-in required for full value').

MacroStateDefinition.description: Definition of a single macro-flow state with its entry action.

entryAction.description: Action performed on entering this state (e.g. 'Speak field group voiceSummary').

isTerminal.description: Whether this state is a terminal state (no outgoing transitions).

MicroFlow.description: Per-field interaction state machine. Governs the capture/confirm/correct cycle for a single field.

initialState.description: State entered when a field receives focus.

states.description: All micro-flow states. Each MicroStateId MUST appear exactly once.

transitions.description: All allowed state transitions. Unlisted transitions are forbidden.

MacroFlow.description: Cross-field-group navigation state machine. Governs the overall process from field-group intro through review/submit or cancel.

initialState.description: State entered when the form dialog starts.

terminalStates.description: States that end the form dialog. Typically SUBMITTED and CANCELLED.

states.description: All macro-flow states. Each MacroStateId MUST appear exactly once.

transitions.description: All allowed state transitions. Unlisted transitions are forbidden.
